text:
jordan: got an SMS from 'Redwood Billing' with a short link asking me to verify an invoice. i clicked from my work laptop to preview and it redirected to a page that looked like a login prompt. did NOT enter creds. forwarding here for triage. link: http://t.ly/abcd1234 :frowning:
jordan: message came at 08:12 PST, from +1 (415) 555-0199. screenshot attached (sent to #eng-security-private).
tara: thanks for the report. was that on a company-managed device?
jordan: yes — macbook (Corp MacBook Pro), MDM enrolled via Jamf, disk encrypted. i ran a quick install of osquery but not a full scan.
mike_sre: copying initial steps. can you drop the shortlink target (no click) and the screenshot into the incident ticket? i'll kick off device scans and check for indicators.
jordan: done — added to ticket 4532 (priv).
mike_sre: running EDR scan + yara quick check. sharing initial output:
```
EDR scan (hostname: JOR-D-MBP): completed 08:35
- no anomalous processes (ps aux) within user session
- no known malware signatures matched in /Users/jordan/*
- network connections: established to 34.120.23.45:80 (shortlink redirect), then to 198.51.100.72:443 (payload host)
- suspicious user-agent observed in redirect: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MSIE 10.0; Windows NT 6.1)
```
mike_sre: no persistence artifacts found on disk. device looks clean but the redirect chain hits a host flagged by multiple threat feeds.
agent-sandbox: sandbox results for http://t.ly/abcd1234 (analyzed 08:42): verdict = evasive. behavior summary = "delays network activity, drops to staged domain on TCP 443, attempts to fingerprint environment, yields benign content when headless chrome detected". indicators: domains [payload-example[.]io, analytics-tracker[.]site], ips [198.51.100.72, 203.0.113.19].
agent-sandbox: file artifacts: none (redirect only). note: redirector chain uses 302 through multiple CDNs, final host attempts to load a fake SSO overlay.
alex: good catch. can we block the listed IPs/domains on egress and add the redirector host to the proxy denylist? also add a rule to the web-filter to expand short links and check destination before allowing.
mike_sre: scheduled egress block pushed to firewall group (short-term) for 198.51.100.72 and 203.0.113.19. proxy denylist updated for payload-example[.]io and analytics-tracker[.]site. added shortlink expansion check to web-filter rules (pilot).
security_oncall: did the user see any OAuth prompts or accept permissions? need to know if an OAuth token was issued.
jordan: i saw a page that looked like an Okta login but i closed it. i didn't enter username/password or accept anything.
mike_sre: verified auth logs — no suspicious SSO auth attempts for jordan's account at 08:12. no tokens issued.
security_oncall: okay — low risk for account compromise. still treat as phishing event and follow-up with user awareness + org-wide advisory for similar SMS.
tara: i'll draft a short all-staff note with examples of the shortlink SMS (sanitized) and steps to take (don’t click, report to #eng-security, send screenshot). will coordinate with comms.
alex: create a detection in our gateway: trigger on 302 chains that resolve to known-malicious IP ranges + UA mismatches; add a Splunk alert. also add a YARA rule for any suspicious redirector HTML patterns.
mike_sre: created Splunk query and saved alert (PHISH_SHORTLINK_REDIRECT). YARA draft pushed to repo under sec-detections/yara/redirectors.yar.
security_oncall: assign owners & blockers:
- containment: mike_sre (firewall/proxy) — done
- device verification: mike_sre — completed
- detection/monitoring: alex — alert + yara
- user comms: tara + comms
- post-incident doc + playbook update: security_oncall
jordan: thanks all. should i still reimage the laptop or just keep EDR watch?
mike_sre: EDR watch for 72h + weekly osquery audit. reimage only if new indicators surface. for now no creds were typed and MDM is intact.
security_oncall: follow-ups:
- update phishing blocklist in proxy (alex) — ETA 1h
- add shortlink expansion check to the web-filter policy (mike_sre) — ETA 3h
- send awareness blurb (tara) — ETA today EOD
- log incident in IR tracker + update playbook with 'sms-shortlink' example (security_oncall) — ETA tomorrow
agent-sandbox: recommended IOC list attached to ticket: [payload-example[.]io, analytics-tracker[.]site, 198.51.100.72, 203.0.113.19, t.ly/abcd1234].
alex: also confirming we should block the sending number at the carrier gate? anyone contact carrier support before? that's usually slow.
tara: we will not escalate to carrier unless we see multiple employees hit the same number. will monitor for repeats.
jordan: appreciate the quick help. i changed my personal login pw out of caution (different account) and deleted the SMS.
security_oncall: closing notes: incident classified as "phishing (shortlink, no credential loss)". severity: low. postmortem: add guidance for previewing shortlinks safely and MDM quick-scan steps.
mike_sre: adding a short doc snippet to the playbook: how to triage shortlink -> sandbox -> block -> monitor.
alex: thumbs up :thumbsup:
security_oncall: tagging for follow-up: mike_sre, alex, tara — will re-open if additional indicators surface. :lock:
